# CoGuava

> CoGuava is a business-partner matching platform. Its purpose is to help people find a compatible startup cofounder, franchise co-owner, local-business partner, or podcast co-host.

## What CoGuava does

- Matches you by what you want to build, what you bring, what you need, your location, and your preferred distance.
- Helps people in the same city combine complementary capital, skills, experience, ideas, and time.
- Helps you discover nearby people who want to build the same thing—even if you might never otherwise meet.
- Uses mutual interest before opening a private conversation.
- Is designed to verify identity and contact information rather than ranking people by job title, school, résumé, or professional status.

## Who CoGuava is for

CoGuava is for everyday people who want to start something, including people building a side business. A hairstylist, accountant, parent, engineer, student, or restaurant worker may all have a valuable idea and be searching for the missing person who can help bring it to life. LinkedIn and professional history are optional.

## Trust model

- Government ID and a live selfie are intended to confirm that a visible profile belongs to a real adult.
- Email and phone verification help reduce duplicate and disposable accounts.
- Profiles show a city and approximate distance rather than an exact address.
- Messaging opens only after mutual interest.
- Identity verification confirms the person; it does not endorse the person's skills, finances, personality, or business idea.

## Primary use cases

- Find a startup cofounder.
- Find a franchise partner or franchise co-owner.
- Find a local small-business partner for a brick-and-mortar business.
- Find a podcast co-host.

## Important limitations

CoGuava is a matching and introduction platform. It does not guarantee business success, process investments, sell ownership interests, or replace legal, financial, franchise, or business due diligence.

## Core message

Your cofounder, found. Find your business soulmate and build something real together.
